trim_effect.trimeffectively.sentry.name: 百步穿杨
trim_effect.trimeffectively.sentry.desc: 哨垒风高，弦随目远；相距愈遥，其势愈沉
trim_effect.trimeffectively.vex.name: 鬼使神差
trim_effect.trimeffectively.vex.desc: 林邸旧怨，寄甲不散；甲上见血，怨影遂生
trim_effect.trimeffectively.wild.name: 奇迹行者
trim_effect.trimeffectively.wild.desc: 荒庙苔深，遗宝识人；凡有所取，常多一获
trim_effect.trimeffectively.coast.name: 浪里白条
trim_effect.trimeffectively.coast.desc: 沉舟遗息，习水知潮；入浪则轻，潜久不迫
trim_effect.trimeffectively.dune.name: 未卜先知
trim_effect.trimeffectively.dune.desc: 沙海辛香，先见来势；其隙未合，刃已复临
trim_effect.trimeffectively.wayfinder.de: 古图刻甲，认得归途；心向生处，山海自短
trim_effect.trimeffectively.raiser.name: 科学配种
trim_effect.trimeffectively.raiser.desc: 牧事知时，蓄育有候；栏中春早，息畜自昌
trim_effect.trimeffectively.shaper.name: 精益求精
trim_effect.trimeffectively.shaper.desc: 旧痕可修，匠气不积；锤下千回，其价如初
trim_effect.trimeffectively.host.name: 劳务合同
trim_effect.trimeffectively.host.desc: 契书在甲，贾客相认；偶有信约，不落账中
trim_effect.trimeffectively.ward.name: 幽匿侵染
trim_effect.trimeffectively.ward.desc: 幽城无目，寄甲为听；八步有声，挥刃成啸
trim_effect.trimeffectively.silence.name: 销声匿迹
trim_effect.trimeffectively.silence.desc: 幽甲衔枚，步下藏声；将响未响，忽入寂中
trim_effect.trimeffectively.tide.name: 涤瑕荡秽
trim_effect.trimeffectively.tide.desc: 海息入甲，浊念自退；潮来一洗，旧厄难留
trim_effect.trimeffectively.snout.name: 拜金主义
trim_effect.trimeffectively.snout.desc: 囊中金响，甲上锋生；财气愈重，一击愈沉
trim_effect.trimeffectively.rib.name: 视死如归
trim_effect.trimeffectively.rib.desc: 负痛如薪，厄念助燃；身陷愈深，刃锋愈烈
trim_effect.trimeffectively.eye.name: 末影化身
trim_effect.trimeffectively.eye.desc: 目及终焉，触则裂实；所存渐薄，终归于无
trim_effect.trimeffectively.spire.name: 动能屏障
trim_effect.trimeffectively.spire.desc: 塔影凌霄，风随身走；疾行之处，刃落皆偏
trim_effect.trimeffectively.bolt.name: 岿然不动
trim_effect.trimeffectively.bolt.desc: 铆钉入骨，甲重如山；风推雷撼，脚底生根
trim_effect.trimeffectively.flow.name: 步步高升
trim_effect.trimeffectively.flow.desc: 涡风藏甲，足下生旋；一落未定，再借风起
trim_effect.trimeffectively.amethyst.des: 晶心共振，危则奋身；命愈垂危，步愈如神
trim_effect.trimeffectively.copper.name: 固若金汤
trim_effect.trimeffectively.copper.desc: 铜壳相衔，柔中藏韧；风雨叩之，其声愈沉
trim_effect.trimeffectively.diamond.name: 金刚不坏
trim_effect.trimeffectively.diamond.desc: 钻纹入骨，岁月难蚀；旧痕未深，其锋如初
trim_effect.trimeffectively.emerald.name: 腰缠万贯
trim_effect.trimeffectively.emerald.desc: 翠玉在甲，贾客眼熟；开口论价，先让一筹
trim_effect.trimeffectively.gold.name: 金光闪闪
trim_effect.trimeffectively.gold.desc: 金辉耀甲，猪灵视金；若本金质，蛮兵亦亲
trim_effect.trimeffectively.iron.name: 百炼成钢
trim_effect.trimeffectively.iron.desc: 铁火相淬，甲骨愈沉；披之在身，锋镝先钝
trim_effect.trimeffectively.lapis.name: 吉人天相
trim_effect.trimeffectively.lapis.desc: 青金通幽，天意微偏；凡有取舍，常得一线
trim_effect.trimeffectively.quartz.name: 针锋相对
trim_effect.trimeffectively.quartz.desc: 石英藏锋，触之则鸣；近身犯甲，自承其锐
trim_effect.trimeffectively.netherite.de: 合金淬火，火不能蚀；焰过其身，留痕不久
trim_effect.trimeffectively.redstone.des: 红石通脉，手足先动；念起未落，击已及石
trim_effect.trimeffectively.resin.name: 岁月史书
trim_effect.trimeffectively.resin.desc: 树脂封岁，旧事成纹；所历种种，皆有所得
